verdict.rationale: First-party docs show Unleash Open Source or Enterprise can be set up in your own environment with Docker or Docker Compose, and the site offers to 'self-host it on your infrastructure.' Community users independently describe and evaluate Unleash as an open-source, self-hosted LaunchDarkly alternative. Missing for 10: production-grade deployment details in the evidence (database configuration, upgrades, scaling of a self-hosted instance).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: This guide helps you set up Unleash Open Source or Unleash Enterprise in your own environment using Docker.
To start the Unleash server, clone the Unleash repository and start the server with Docker Compose
Run it in our cloud or self-host it on your infrastructure.
Asked for an open-source, self-hosted alternative to LaunchDarkly, a commenter recommended Unleash (github.com/Unleash/unleash).
